protocol: First crossing only. Both alarm-disabled detectors are read up to their first threshold crossing; R4 re-arms a monitor after every alarm and scores pre-drift alarms as false positives, and that post-re-arm behaviour is NOT reconstructed here. A cell whose pre_drift_alarm_rate is 1.0 therefore carries no post-drift detection reading, and its detect_within_W_rate of 0 means 'not measured by this pass', not 'measured and negative'. ADWIN is exempt: it carries no threshold, so its alarms are live and its counts are complete.
